comments.body:
For Glamsterdam, we need to decide between two proposed fixes for a minor problem with bids:

* https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5774
* https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5776

I prefer 5776 even though it's a little more complex. It will make p2p bids more competitive while still avoiding spam.

suggestion for approaching hegota CFI -> SFI:

* get FOCIL stable on a hegota devnet (with frames)
* then add in the other CFI EIPs except for quick slots, as they are less complex than QS may be. may be useful to also pace this batch
* QS champions should work on a fork of the latest hegota devnet (i.e. it tracks ongoing development) w/ the EIP added to help resolve any open engineering questions, and start doing the application layer work (which will be the bulk of this AFAICT). 

note: i'd expect multiple hegota-plus-qs devnets in parallel with hegota work until they can be merged together

Some FOCIL clarification: because inclusion lists are delivered via `engine_forkchoiceUpdated` payload attributes and the engine API treats any attribute change as "begin a new build process", ELs throw away their payload and rebuild from scratch ~2s before the slot instead of appending the missing IL transactions as EIP-7805 intends, which causes most of the missed and late blocks under full blocks. Proposed clarification: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/964

EIP-8365: now that [EIPs#12533](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12533) grandfathers the pending queue, the only remaining difference from [EIPs#12513](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12513) / [consensus-specs#5744](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5744) is whether a validly signed post-fork `0x00` deposit gets burned or registered but never activated until `BLSToExecutionChange`: do client teams prefer burning ETH or the activation gate?

For the CFI → SFI check-in: [EIPs#12570](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12570) proposes allowing SFI decisions on ACDT as well as ACDE/ACDC (agenda posted a day ahead), so mature devnet EIPs don't wait up to two weeks for ratification while their specs stay off main; would like to hear whether people share the concern raised there about ACDT attendance. - Maybe defer decision to Devcon?

For general scoping: [pm#2275](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/pull/2275) proposes that EIPs still open as PRs in ethereum/EIPs can be PFI'd but aren't put on call agendas until merged, and that a PFI'd EIP with no client team supporting it by the end of the discussion window defaults to DFI; any general feedback from client teams? - Maybe defer decision to Devcon?

Longer term for `0x00`/BLS ahead of post-quantum: can we commit to a fixed three-fork plan, stopping new `0x00` validators in Hegotá ([EIP-8365](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8365)), exiting all remaining `0x00` validators in the following fork ([EIP-8433](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8433)), and removing `BLSToExecutionChange` in the fork after, and announce it in an EF blog post now so holders have several forks of notice to switch their credentials?
